project.title: Ride Slowly, Ride Safely
project.logline: Two young brothers learn that safe cycling matters more than winning a race.

story.idea: Alex and Bob are young brothers cycling in a park. Bob races toward a branch and has a mild fall. Alex comforts him, and Bob learns to ride slowly and safely.
story.theme: Safety is more important than speed.
story.moral: Ride slowly, watch the path, and help each other.

generation_policy.dialogue_overflow_action: shorten or split into consecutive single-speaker clips; never increase speech speed

generation_policy.timing_block_rule: Copy mandatory_video_audio_timing_block verbatim immediately before Dialogue in every video_audio_prompt.
generation_policy.more_than_two_primary_characters_action: Ask the user to select the two recurring characters who require consistency before creating the prompt book; do not select on the user's behalf.
generation_policy.intake_note: For the strongest visual and identity consistency, VideoExpress works best with a maximum of two recurring consistent characters. generation_policy.character_reference_framing: neutral full-body or three-quarter full-length; head-to-toe child proportions visible
generation_policy.positive_prompt_compilation_rule: Prepend the exact identity_lock for every visible recurring character to both image and video prompts.
generation_policy.negative_prompt_compilation_rule: Prepend generation_policy.global_negative_prompt to every shot-specific image and video negative prompt.
generation_policy.wrong_gender_or_identity_result_action: reject and regenerate the same shot before video or timeline insertion
generation_policy.dialogue_format: Quotation marks appear only around the exact sentence to be spoken. Voice and emotion instructions are unquoted.
generation_policy.acceptance_policy: Accept the first completed take only after dialogue timing and structural identity/gender checks pass.

dialogue_timing_policy.speaker_rule: Exactly one visible character speaks per clip; split two-character exchanges into consecutive clips.
dialogue_timing_policy.ten_second_rule: Start naturally, finish the complete line by second 7-8, then leave 2-3 seconds for reaction or settling action.
dialogue_timing_policy.dialogue_writing_rule: Use one compact sentence with no ellipses, em dashes, staged pauses, pause instructions, or multiple separated thoughts.
dialogue_timing_policy.reaction_time_placement: Only after the complete spoken line; never before or between phrases.
dead_air_acceptance_gate: first spoken word begins no later than 0.8 seconds
no internal silent gap exceeds 0.35 seconds
the line is complete by second 8

dialogue_timing_policy.dead_air_failure_action: Reject and regenerate the same clip with the identical timing block; do not accept a clip that requires manual removal of initial or internal dead air.
pre_submit_checks: the quoted line appears exactly once
speaker character, face, reference, voice lock, and audio sample all share the same character_id

character_identity_policy.immutable_slot_rule: SLOT_A and SLOT_B are assigned once and never swapped across actor order, reference selection, prompts, or shots.
character_identity_policy.reference_selection_rule: Select every reference by recorded asset ID, never by thumbnail position.

character_identity_policy.failure_action: Reject wrong-gender, swapped, duplicated, merged, or visibly morphed characters and regenerate the same shot. Never add a known identity failure to the timeline.

SCALE_BOB_01: exactly 14-year-old boy, 160 cm tall, seven-and-a-half-head young-teen proportion, lean young-teen body, narrow youthful shoulders, child-sized hands and limbs; Bob is exactly 106.7 percent of Alex's standing height. ENV_PARK_01: peaceful neighborhood park, late afternoon, clear pale-blue sky, dry weather, warm diffuse sunlight from camera-left, soft short shadows, completely dry asphalt path, green grass, fixed large oak tree, low flower bed, and wooden bench; no weather, lighting, shadow, ground, or landmark change. Bob sits on grass holding one elbow with watery eyes, one soft tear, pinched brows, and a small wince. Alex kneels nearby and offers his hand. Delivery mode: on-camera lip sync. Bob remains visible front or three-quarter with his complete mouth unobstructed and naturally articulates every word in exact sync; Alex's mouth remains closed and still. Timing: Start the first spoken word at 0.5 seconds and no later than 0.8 seconds. Speak the complete line continuously in one natural take with no hesitation, delayed start, long gap, or mid-sentence pause. Keep any natural word-to-word pause under 0.35 seconds. Finish the full line by second 8. Place all silent reaction time only after the dialogue is complete. Dialogue: Bob says, "My elbow hurts Alex, but now I will ride safely." Voice: 14-year-old boy; soft friendly youthful male voice; medium pitch slightly lower than Alex; gentle breath; 90-100 words per minute; neutral American English; clear consonants; no adult or deep tone. Emotion: begin with a soft tearful tremble, then sound relieved and sincere; no loud crying.
shots.video_negative_prompt: narration, voiceover, off-screen speech, disembodied voice, speaker off camera, closed speaker mouth, frozen mouth, mismatched lip movement, Alex lip movement, both mouths moving, subtitles, captions, closed captions, burned-in text, dialogue text, speech bubbles, lower thirds, title cards, words, letters, adult body, size drift, height change, giant child, tiny child, forced perspective, fisheye, rain, wet pavement, umbrella, changing weather, changing light, hard long shadows, loud sobbing, screaming, blood, visible wound, gore
shots.negative_constraints: adult body, adult proportions, broad shoulders, muscular torso, tall adult height, mature face, facial hair, loud sobbing, screaming, blood, visible wound, gore

voice_replacement_plan.method: Right-click each timeline clip, select Voice Changer, choose the speaker's saved My AI Audio sample, and click Apply.
voice_replacement_plan.selection_rule: Select by exact recorded voice_sample_asset_id or exact saved name; never choose by list position.
voice_replacement_plan.immutable_mapping_rule: The speaker_character_id, voice_lock_id, and voice_sample_asset_id tuple must never change.
voice_replacement_plan.mismatch_action: Reapply the same saved sample once, then regenerate or reapply if still wrong; never switch to another character's sample.

subtitle_policy.positive_video_prompt_rule: Do not mention subtitles, captions, or no text in the positive video prompt.
subtitle_policy.video_negative_prompt_terms: subtitles, captions, closed captions, burned-in text, dialogue text, speech bubbles, lower thirds, title cards, words, letters
subtitle_policy.verification: No subtitle, caption, title, or text-generation step and no text layer on the timeline.
